medium.description: medium Independent noise-gated position, scale, RGB separation and light bursts, each with amount and frequency. Constant motion blur follows position/scale speed. Non-periodic; no rotation; Repeat or Hold edges.

strong.description: strong Independent noise-gated position, scale, RGB separation and light bursts, each with amount and frequency. Constant motion blur follows position/scale speed. Non-periodic; no rotation; Repeat or Hold edges.
